text:
Carla Ramos: tagging the runtime folks — I'm gating PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4321 on the architecture RFC. RFC link: https://redwood-inference.com/rfcs/2026-02-routing-variants (see §4). The PR wires up routing fallback + model-variant mapping. @Ben @Dave @Emily, can you eyeball the design before we merge? TL;DR: add routing policy table, X-RW-Route fallback header, and an in-memory fallback map. Will add unit tests after design sign-off.

Ben Patel: quick Q — does this change KV-cache semantics or eviction behavior? If so we need to know perf impact (p95 tokens/sec + mem delta). Can you paste the expected numbers here?

Carla Ramos: short summary from RFC §4.1: cache semantics unchanged for hot prefixes; fallback only triggers a variant lookup which hits the small in-memory map (O(1)). Expected perf: ~1–2% extra CPU for routing on 8k seqs, mem +12MB per worker for the fallback map at current policy sizes. Those are numbers from the RFC perf appendix. I can paste the perf table if you want.

Dave Nguyen: :eyes: two quick architecture notes: (1) trusting X-RW-Route header when behind proxies is risky, we must validate forwarders or use signed routing tokens; (2) prefer config to live in a separate store (ConfigMap or KV) rather than env var so rollouts don't require restarts. Otherwise looks reasonable.

Carla Ramos: good points. We'll validate proxy IPs in the ingress and fall back to signed tokens if header present. I'll switch policy storage to a ConfigMap-like object (implemented as runtime-config fetch) instead of env. Will update PR.

Emily Zhao: thanks for the ping. I'm the author of the RFC — confirming this PR is aligned with the proposal as long as we include a deterministic rollback route (RFC §4.2). I can add a short paragraph and grant RFC sign-off once the PR includes the rollback and the proxy validation notes.

rfc-bot: RFC referenced: 2026-02-routing-variants — status: under review. Linked PR: #4321.

Carla Ramos: thank you — added rollback route + proxy validation notes in the latest commit. Tests added for fallback selection and header parsing. PTAL.

Ben Patel: I'll review the PR later today and focus on perf tests and cache safety. :+1:

merge-bot: PR #4321 is currently blocked by rfc-2026-02 gating requirement. Remove blocker after RFC approval.

Dave Nguyen: small nit: can we rename header to X-RW-Fallback-Route to be explicit? Also add a unit that simulates a forwarded header from multiple proxies. Otherwise I can give final sign-off after Ben's perf pass.

Carla Ramos: renamed header to X-RW-Fallback-Route and added a test for multi-proxy X-Forwarded-For parsing. Pushed commit 0f1e2d3 (abc123 for short).

Emily Zhao: I updated the RFC with the rollback paragraph and proxy validation details. I left an inline note and then marked the RFC as APPROVED.

rfc-bot: RFC 2026-02 status: approved by Emily Zhao.

merge-bot: Re-checking PR #4321 — RFC gate OK. Blocking label removed.

Carla Ramos: great — merging in ~10m unless any objections. Thanks all for the quick reviews. :shipit:

Ben Patel: thumbs up from me, will follow up if anything pops in staging.

Dave Nguyen: SGTM, thanks for addressing the nit.

Carla Ramos: merged. Closing thread.
